output.summary: The run is VALID but the analysis coverage is INCOMPLETE and the capacity verdict is INDETERMINATE, so NO_POLICY is the overall policy verdict — this is not a pass. Business-level metrics look healthy (0 errors, moderate latency: overall p50 103ms, p95 299ms, p99 600ms, max 1299ms over 47,396 samples; window business_verdict PASS), but the load stage "d16-cpu-limited-20users" failed its resource guard: the JMeter generator host ran heavily CPU-throttled (cfs_throttled_period_ratio median 1, mean 0.861, max 1 vs threshold 0.2; guard FAIL; finding reports 27 cells with observed_min 0.3958). Because the load generator was throttled during most of the window, the intended 20-user load cannot be considered verified; verified_bound_load is null, stages are INDETERMINATE with reason CAPACITY_GUARD_FAILED / CAPACITY_STAGE_NOT_VERIFIED, and no capacity knee was computed (KNEE_DETECTOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED). The business window PASS must not be read as a capacity PASS. Clock alignment is not verified by the core, so no temporal or lead/lag causal claims are supported.

hypotheses.recommended_check: Re-run the stage while monitoring jmeter-generator cfs_throttled_period_ratio per cell and confirm the resource guard stays below the 0.2 threshold (or otherwise passes) for all cells before accepting the stage as verified.

hypotheses.recommended_check: Inspect the generator host's CPU quota/cgroup limits, core allocation, and co-located workloads, and compare measured CPU demand to the allocated limit to determine why throttling persisted.
